title: Sep 30 Results + Oct 1 Preview: Split Decision, Same Matchup
summary: Sep 30 brought us a 2-2 split—here's what happened and why we're eyeing the Braves again.

content.value:
## The Thing About September 30th

Here's the thing about a 50-50 day: it's both humbling and clarifying. We went 2-2 on September 30th, splitting our picks right down the middle. Not the sweep we dream about, but not a disaster either. Just baseball doing what baseball does—keeping us honest.

## How The Day Unfolded

The story of yesterday was really a tale of two halves. Our higher-confidence picks—the Braves and Astros at 62%—didn't pan out. Meanwhile, our coin-flip Yankees call at 50%? Hit. The Padres came through for us too at 62%, salvaging what could've been a rougher night.

## The Braves-Phillies Storyline

What's particularly interesting? The Phillies beat the Braves yesterday, but we're going right back to Atlanta for tomorrow's top pick. Sometimes the model sees something in the matchup that transcends one game's result. It's about the bigger picture—the pitching, the trends, the numbers beneath the surface.

content.title: ⭐ October 1 Top Pick
content.sub: 61% win probability vs Phillies | Wheeler vs Suter on the mound

content.value:
## Tomorrow's Lens: October 1st

The calendar flips to October tomorrow, and we're staying loyal to the Braves at home. At 61% confidence, it's not our strongest pick ever, but there's conviction here. Zack Wheeler takes the ball for Philadelphia while Brent Suter gets the nod for Atlanta.

The pitching matchup tells part of the story, but so does the home-field factor and how these teams match up head-to-head. After yesterday's loss, we're betting the Braves bounce back in front of their crowd.

## The Bigger Picture

A .500 day isn't what we aim for, but it's part of the journey. The Yankees and Padres reminded us that the model can find value even when confidence isn't sky-high. The Braves and Astros reminded us that favorites don't always win—that's why they play the games.

Tomorrow's another chance. Another slate. Another opportunity for the numbers to tell their story. And this time, we're hoping Atlanta writes a different ending.

author: Hana
